name: 8280-batchdecode-dsv2lite-8gpu
hardware: 8x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, SM90, one node. No router, no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp8 with data-parallel attention eight ways (dp8): attention per rank over that rank's own tokens, FFN and MoE over every rank's tokens concatenated.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, first 15% warmup, bounded at 512 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, over /v1/completions, no prefix structure: 1000 prompt tokens in and 1000 generated out, both fixed (stdev 0), ignore_eos true and temperature 0.0 in backend.extras.body. Seed 8280.
purpose: A code-generation assistant serving 256 concurrent developers with thousand-token prompts and thousand-token completions on eight GPUs.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang at the commit named by `configs/setupcard.md: commit_id`.
# FLAT PARSER: `sglang serve` CLI form, one `key: value` per line. A nested block, or a structured
#   value re-flowed across lines, is DROPPED silently and the engine starts without it at rc=0.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct

# The checkpoint ships its own configuration and modeling modules.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 8
enable-dp-attention: true
dp-size: 8

# LOAD-BEARING, NOT COSMETIC: the checkpoint advertises 163840 positions, and the engine sizes a
# device-side int32 req_to_token table of (max requests + 1) x (context length + 4) from that
# number -- over a terabyte at the advertised window, and the server never starts. 4096 is the
# checkpoint's own pre-YaRN window; the longest request here is 2000 tokens, so nothing truncates.
context-length: 4096

random-seed: 42
